[Page context: the user has the Claim record "00002566: Burst pipe flooded finished basement" open (object Case, Id 500aj00003jfwTqAAI). "This", "here" and "this claim" refer to that record.]

Set this claim to Waiting on Customer.

I can't set claim 00002566 to Waiting on Customer, because that status is only for service requests. A claim can move through **New, Under Investigation, Appraisal, Approved, Payment Issued**, then **Closed** or **Denied**. It's at Under Investigation now.

The mitigation invoice and the rebuild estimate are both attached, so Appraisal might be the next step. Do you want me to prepare that move, or a different status? If you're waiting on Chinedu Okafor for something, I can set up a follow-up task instead.
